_note: Tier-1 sweep batch 010, April-June 2024. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He is praying protection over the Fourth of July and over Donald Trump, that he be sheltered and that no calamity reach him.
mentions.quote: praying over protection for the 4th of July praying over protection over Donald
mentions.condition_text: framed as intercession against the thing seen
mentions.falsify_match: An attack over the Fourth of July 2024 or an attempt on Trump.
mentions.falsify_miss: The holiday and Trump both pass unharmed, which he pre-attributes to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: Retaliation is coming and America must be prayed over for the Fourth of July weekend and for the elections, which he says are serious enough that it is an open question whether one is held at all.
mentions.quote: it's a very serious time even if we even have one
mentions.condition_text: he calls for prayer over both the holiday and the election
mentions.falsify_match: A retaliatory attack over the Fourth of July, or the 2024 election being disrupted or cancelled.
mentions.falsify_miss: The holiday passes quietly and the election is held normally.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for an exposing of hidden things including corruption among pastors and in the church.
mentions.quote: all things that are hidden will be exposed and revealed
mentions.condition_text: spoken as a prayer calling the exposure in
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of exposures of church leadership.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls being warned about a shifting of finances toward cryptocurrencies and about 2024, and about the glory manifesting in his house during prayer.
mentions.quote: the shifting to cryptocurrencies the shifting to financial things happening
mentions.falsify_match: A visible shift of finance toward crypto during 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He declares spiritual babies coming forth, marriages restored and new children raised in godly homes through the channel.
mentions.quote: babies coming forth out of people's lives and their marriages being restored
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; a declaration over the audience.

mentions.claim_text: He opens by taking the question people keep asking him about what is going on between Israel and Iran.
mentions.quote: what do you feel about what's going on with Israel and Iran right now
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not bring these things to scare people but to shake them, because big things are happening and Jesus is coming soon.
mentions.quote: I try to shake you all because big things are happening
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a statement of intent.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not scoreable; a statement of intent.

mentions.claim_text: He says the black horse comes later, but that the American economy is about to crash and he has seen it for 2025.
mentions.quote: we're about to see the economy of America crash I believe in 2025
mentions.falsify_match: A crash of the US economy during 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says God has not abandoned listeners but that what is about to happen brings pressure and a refiner's fire, a cocoon out of which they emerge as butterflies.
mentions.quote: through that cocoon you will become the beautiful butterfly
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; a pastoral framing of hardship.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for angels coming out of a portal and for warnings given in the midnight hour, and prays over the electric grid at Miami.
mentions.quote: if it's about the electric grid over Miami
mentions.condition_text: prayed against in the same breath
mentions.falsify_match: A grid failure or attack at Miami.

mentions.claim_text: He identifies what he was shown as wormwood from Revelation, a massive asteroid scheduled to hit the planet, which he places in 2029.
mentions.quote: a massive asteroid that is scheduled to hit I believe in 2029
mentions.falsify_match: An asteroid impacts the earth in 2029.
mentions.falsify_miss: Apophis passes without impact, as currently calculated.

mentions.claim_text: He notes that others say the 2029 asteroid is supposed to miss the earth but says he believes there will be a direct impact soon, whether or not the rapture has happened first.
mentions.quote: I believe we're going to have a direct impact from this soon
mentions.falsify_match: A direct asteroid impact on earth by the end of 2029.
mentions.falsify_miss: No impact; the object passes as calculated.

mentions.claim_text: He says his prophetic calendar runs feast to feast, Rosh Hashanah to Rosh Hashanah, not January to January, and points to the coming September as the start of a year.
mentions.quote: my calendar is from roash to roash
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable on its own; it fixes how his year claims should be read.

mentions.claim_text: A shmita cycle ran last year so six more years remain until the next, which he says as his opinion is a great time for the rapture, and he touches on the Revelation 12 sign.
mentions.quote: six more years until the next shita cycle that's a great time for the Rapture
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable by ordinary evidence; explicitly his opinion.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hopes Jesus returns today or this year, and notes reports that a peace agreement with Syria is being delayed.
mentions.quote: they said they were delaying the peace agreement with Syria
mentions.falsify_match: An Israel-Syria peace agreement is signed after the reported delay.

mentions.claim_text: He points at something in England and says he does not know whether it is the major plague he was shown or a rehearsal for it, adding that what was supernatural is starting to manifest in the natural.
mentions.quote: what the Lord showed me about the major plague or practicing for it
mentions.falsify_match: A serious outbreak or a pandemic exercise in England in 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees many requests for healing and deliverance, including people needing new body parts, and takes that up as the subject.
mentions.quote: people asking for prayer for healing and for deliverance and needing new body
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; framing for a healing session.

mentions.claim_text: Another massive wave of plague is coming after COVID, which ran from 2020 into 2022 and then receded; he explicitly declines to give the time frame.
mentions.quote: another wave another massive wave the first wave was covid
mentions.falsify_match: A second pandemic wave on or beyond COVID scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: No second pandemic, though with no date this cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He says the beginning of a world war is now visible and that two years earlier he saw Israel escalating against Iran when nothing of the kind was happening.
mentions.quote: I saw Israel going and escalating against Iran this was two years ago
mentions.falsify_match: Direct Israel-Iran escalation after a 2022 word.

mentions.claim_text: He apologises about dates, says that if his arithmetic on the 569 days was off the thing still happened inside the window the angel gave.
mentions.quote: I'm sorry about the dates if I didn't do the math right
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a retrospective widening of an earlier exact date.

mentions.claim_text: He answers the objection that he had said the return was not soon, pointing back to a vision from 2020 around COVID, and insists we are in the end times and very close.
mentions.quote: I had that back in 2020 way back around covid time
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable by ordinary evidence.

mentions.claim_text: He describes writing Megan's complete restoration on the family list every year, down to details such as being potty trained, and expecting full manifestation.
mentions.quote: every single time that Megan is going to be completely restored
mentions.condition_text: held as a standing faith declaration
mentions.falsify_match: Not independently scoreable; a private healing declaration.

mentions.claim_text: In the throne room he saw spoken words stay alive like seeds in front of your face, never dying but growing and putting down roots.
mentions.quote: the words would stay alive they were like a seed
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable by ordinary evidence; a vision of how words work.

mentions.claim_text: He opens by taking the question about Israel and Iran, in a passage duplicated in the June upload of the same session.
mentions.quote: what do you feel about what's going on with Israel and Iran right now
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; framing.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the aim is to shake rather than scare, because big things are happening and Jesus is coming soon. Duplicated in the June upload.
mentions.quote: I try to shake you all because big things are happening
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a statement of intent.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not scoreable; a statement of intent.
